text: Atlas membership is now exposed through one shared existential AtlasQuotient for volume and bilateral surface representations. Parcel metadata is AtlasRegionMetadata indexed by parcel space; Region remains only a deprecated metadata alias. Complete network annotations validate as a parcel-to-network Surjection and network regions are fibers of the composed quotient. Standard mean/sum reductions are one-pass quotient aggregations; custom reducer functions remain a compatibility path. Overlap defaults to exact grids and requires AtlasAlignment.NearestNeighborToFirst for explicit resampling. Parcel adjacency is the relation p-converse;A;p, while ParcelContact is the distinct optimized weighted boundary result.
